name: last-mile-rehearsal
title: The last mile of the guide, rehearsed on a real commit
description: Every script step of the turn guide is exercised by a test and every tool step needs the host. What no test did was the chain the guide promises at step 7: a real commit, its declared surface, the verifier answer and the decision line. The root commit of this repository is resolvable at runtime and touches .agents/skills, which is the skill component - so it can be inside one surface and outside another
